size.note: floor/ceil in world meters baseboard/cove bevel width. wall in UV fraction 0-0.5. cornerRadius reserved (legacy)

shading.note: darken = AO in crevice 0=black crevice 1=no darken. roundCorners = use spherical interpolation vs flat bevel. blend = normal mix strength. affectRoughness = roughness darken factor in chamfer

trim.note: Trim highlight added in middle of bevel band as albedo += trimBand * strength. Simulates baseboard catching light

ranges.note: Thresholds for smoothstep shaping: crevice AO fades, trim highlight band, roughness mix
